description: Use AI to design a new OG image template from a website's brand (logo, colors, fonts) taken from a URL. Returns the chosen layoutId (a built-in template id usable with generate_og_image), the variables to pass, and the extracted brand kit. Counts against the plan's AI quota.

url.description: The URL of the website whose brand (logo, colors, fonts) the new template is designed from.

name: create_template_from_url
